newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stock market trade surges, index steady.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stock market trade surges, index steady.

text.p: Trade surged on the Bahrain stock exchange last week with activity focused on the banking sector, but the share index hovered around previous levels, the Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said.
The index reached 1,548.15 points in the week to Thursday, up 0.26 points from 1,547.89 points the previous week.
Trading volume soared to 18 million shares worth 3.36 million dinars ($8.9 million) from five million shares worth 1.4 million dinars last week.
Shares of 24 firms out of 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 177 transactions, the stock exchange said.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors. ($1=0.377 dinar)
